nodes.description: Owner address stored in BotProtected; assigned from tx.origin in BabyFlokiDoge constructor and used as the only privileged account.
Address of the external Ferrum bot-protection contract that is target of low-level calls.
Uniswap pair address computed in constructor and passed into bot-protection calls.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated in transferFrom, distribute and list.
Public nested mapping of allowances; unlimited allowances are granted in the constructor.
Fixed total supply set at construction and used in list arithmetic.
Hard-coded Uniswap V2 router interface used for addLiquidityETH.
Wrapped BNB address used when computing the pair.
Sets stopTheBots to the supplied bot-protection address.
Modifier performing a low-level call to stopTheBots before executing the guarded function.
Initializes owner from tx.origin, computes uniPair and grants unlimited allowances.
Payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender.
Guarded by checkBots; performs unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
Sets allowance mapping entry for msg.sender.
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall with user-supplied address and calldata.
Pure helper that derives the Uniswap pair address from two tokens.
Owner-only mass balance overwrite that calls stopTheBots before writing balances.
Owner-only listing routine that mints balances, adds liquidity and mass-distributes.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, allowance and transfer logic.
Transaction origin used to set owner and to grant unlimited allowances.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to compute the Uniswap deadline.
delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata inside delegate().
Low-level stopTheBots.call in checkBots modifier; return value only partially validated and executed before state changes.
Low-level stopTheBots.call inside distribute() before balance writes; return value ignored.
Low-level stopTheBots.call inside list() before mass balance writes; return value ignored.
External router call forwarding msg.value and using a block.timestamp-derived deadline.
Unchecked balanceOf subtraction and addition in transferFrom (Solidity 0.7, no SafeMath).
Unchecked allowance deduction in transferFrom without SafeMath.
Unchecked arithmetic totalSupply * 6 / 100 and balance assignment in list().

Per-recipient amounts used in list().

edges.reason: BabyFlokiDoge constructor assigns owner = tx.origin, making ownership depend on the transaction origin, which is phishable.
Constructor grants tx.origin an unlimited allowance on the pair, so any origin impersonation gains full spending rights.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom, inheriting its guard and arithmetic.
_value parameter drives allowance and balance updates in transferFrom.
stopTheBots state variable is the target address of the low-level call in checkBots.
The checkBots modifier executes the external stopTheBots call before the transferFrom body.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] and added to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
_value is deducted from allowance[_from][msg.sender] with unchecked arithmetic.
delegate() executes a delegatecall with caller-supplied address and calldata.
delegate() authorizes the action by comparing msg.sender with owner.
owner state variable is the reference for the delegate() authorization check.
The delegatecall result is captured in the success local variable and returned.
distribute() performs a low-level stopTheBots call before writing balances.
list() performs a low-level stopTheBots call before writing balances.
list() calls addLiquidityETH on the Uniswap router forwarding msg.value.
routerForUniswap state variable is the target of the addLiquidityETH call.
The router deadline is block.timestamp + 600, a miner-influenced value.
totalSupply is used in the unchecked expression totalSupply * 6 / 100.
list() performs unchecked multiplication/division and direct balance assignment.
External call into stopTheBots occurs in the modifier before allowance and balance state updates in transferFrom.
stopTheBots external call precedes the balance writes inside distribute().
stopTheBots external call precedes the balance writes inside list().
distribute() requires msg.sender to equal owner before overwriting balances.
list() requires msg.sender to equal owner before minting and distributing balances.
msg.sender is checked against owner at the start of distribute().
The constructor reads tx.origin to establish ownership and allowances.
_tooWho is ABI-encoded and passed into the stopTheBots call in distribute().
_tooWho is ABI-encoded and passed into the stopTheBots call in list().
uniPair state variable is set from the pairForPancake helper.
uniPair is encoded into the selector payload of the stopTheBots call in checkBots.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only sets the stopTheBots state variable inside the constructor.
Source address parameter consumed by the allowance and balance logic of transferFrom.
Destination address parameter consumed by the balance credit logic of transferFrom.
Amount parameter flows into the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic of transferFrom.
Spender address parameter only used to key the allowance mapping in approve().
Target address parameter is the destination of the delegatecall operation.
Calldata parameter is forwarded verbatim to the delegatecall operation.
First token parameter only participates in the pair computation helper.
Second token parameter only participates in the pair computation helper.
Recipient array parameter is consumed by the mass balance writes in list().
Amount parameter is assigned to every recipient balance in distribute().
Token amount parameter sets the contract balance and liquidity amount in list().
Amount array parameter supplies the per-recipient balances in list().
Local boolean is the direct return value of the stopTheBots low-level call.
Local bytes buffer holds the returndata of the stopTheBots low-level call and is unused.
Local flag is the direct return value of the delegatecall operation.
Local stores the address computed by the pair derivation helper.
Local holds the ordered lower token address in the pair computation.
Local holds the ordered higher token address in the pair computation.
Loop counter only iterates the balance-assignment loop in distribute().
